tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind the shell. Ink 950 in dark.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Top bar, side nav, main panels. Ink 900 in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inputs, code boxes, cards inside a panel, badge name segment. Ink 850.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, menus, popovers: elevation is a lighter ink, not a shadow. Ink 800.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and table borders. Ink 700.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button and input borders (3:1 against canvas).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, canvas, surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, secondary values.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, placeholders. Passes 4.5:1 on canvas and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tab underline, focus border, running state. Microcks Blue.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action fills. Dark ink on bright blue in dark theme.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, mock URLs, inline values. Cloud Blue in dark.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected row, selected operation.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 4px halo around focused controls, together with an action-colored border.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Baseline Pink. ONLY for live signals: streaming test, live traces, recording dot. Never a status.

tokens.name: live-text
tokens.usage: Text next to a live dot.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passing test, conformant operation. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed test, destructive action. Coral, kept away from live pink by lightness. Always with an icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Partial conformance, AI-generated content awaiting review, timeouts.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: In-progress test or import.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on a filled status segment.

tokens.name: proto-rest
tokens.usage: REST / OpenAPI / Swagger / Postman / HAR services.

tokens.name: proto-soap
tokens.usage: SOAP / SoapUI / WSDL services.

tokens.name: proto-event
tokens.usage: AsyncAPI event-driven services (Kafka, MQTT, AMQP, NATS, WebSocket…).

tokens.name: proto-grpc
tokens.usage: gRPC / Protobuf services.

tokens.name: proto-graphql
tokens.usage: GraphQL services.

tokens.name: proto-direct
tokens.usage: Direct API / generic services created without a contract.

tokens.name: on-proto
tokens.usage: Text on a protocol-filled badge segment.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Logo blue, brand moments. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-cloud
tokens.usage: Logo light blue, brand moments.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep brand blue for large brand fields.

tokens.name: brand-pink
tokens.usage: Logo baseline pink. Brand and live only.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink, the blue-black ground.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Service name on detail pages, big numbers (conformance %). Max one per screen.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Paths, URLs, payloads, identifiers. Anything machine-readable.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: API badge segments and method tags.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in dense lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty states and drop zones only.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, method tags. Near-square, sturdy.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: API badges (shield).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, code boxes.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Drop zones, trace graph nodes, command palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Label chips and live indicator only.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus halo. The only glow allowed.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette, menus, dialogs. Nothing else casts a shadow.
